t: Flomasta PipeGrip Socket-Stem Elbow is a push-fit water pipe fitting that connects 10mm pipe to 15mm pipe at a 90° angle. With a dual locking system and green band indicator, it ensures a secure, leak-free connection. WRAS approved and compatible with copper or plastic pipe, these pipe elbows are perfect for smooth, space-saving transitions in smaller pipe runs.
